Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 2019
ACT VI OF 2019
BALOCHISTAN ESSENTIAL EDUCATION
SERVICES ACT, 2019
An Act to declare the Education Services in
Balochistan as Essential Services and for better regulation of Education
Services in Balochistan and the matters connected therewith or incidental
thereto
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
26th August, 2019]
No.PAB/Legis;
V (01)/2019, dated 26.8.2019.---The
Balochistan Essential Education Services Bill 2019 Bill No. 01 of 2019 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 10th August, 2019 and
assented to by the Governor Balochistan, on 19th August, 2019 is hereby
published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to make provisions for
Education Services so as to make the Education Service, professional
disciplined, efficient and accountable service and to run the affairs of said
service in smooth and systematic way; and
WHEREAS,
it is necessary to declare the Education Service as essential service, by
prohibiting strikes, lockouts and other illegal; means or ways used by the
members of the said service and to make provisions for punishment of such
illegal acts, so as to manage the provision of Education in its true
perspective.
It
is hereby enacted as follows: -
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Balochistan Essential Education Services Act, 2019.
(2) It
shall apply to all members of the Education Services, serving in Balochistan.
(3) It
shall come into force at once.

Definition

is hereby enacted as follows: -
2. Definition.---In this Act, unless there is anything repugnant
in the subject or context,-
(a) "Act"
means the Balochistan Essential Education Services Act, 2019;
(b) "Code"
means the Criminal Procedure Code, 1898 (Act V of 1898);
(c) "Court"
means the court of magistrate first class;
(d) "Essential
Service" means the Essential Service of the Education Department declared
as such under Section 3 of this Act.
(e) "Education
institute" means any primary, middle, High or Higher Secondary or for that
purpose any such place so declared by the Department where formal or informal
education is imparted.
(f) "Education
Service" means any service of the Education Department consisting of its
employees irrespective of their categories, imparting education or serving in
any other capacity in an Education Institution or in any office of the
Education Department.
(g) "Government"
means The Government of Balochistan.
(h) "Illegal
act" means any act which is not legal under any law.
(i) "Lockout"
means the closure of public offices or any educational institute.
(j) "Member
of Education Service" means and include all officers and officials
appointed in the Education Department, irrespective of their grade designation
and place of posting;
(k) "Prescribed"
means prescribed by rules;
(l) "Rules"
means rules made under this Act; and
(m) "Strike"
means the cession or refusal of work by a body of persons or an individual
employed in Education Service;

Declaration of Essential Service and prohibition of Strike, lockout and other illegal acts

Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to make provisions for
Education Services so as to make the Education Service, professional

WHEREAS,
it is necessary to declare the Education Service as essential service, by

members of the said service and to make provisions for punishment of such
illegal acts, so as to manage the provision of Education in its true
perspective.
It
is hereby enacted as follows: -
3. Declaration
of Essential Service and prohibition of Strike, lockout and other illegal acts.---(1) The Government may, by notification in the
official Gazette, declare any Education Service to be an Essential Service
under this Act, for such period as it may deem fit in the best interest of
Education and Public.
(2) No
member of the Education service shall be
allowed to go or attend to go, call or attend to call, participate or attempt
to participate, instigate or attempt to instigate for a strike or lockout or
any illegal act.

4. Resignation
as protest during strike.---(1)
During the course of strike, the resignation tendered as protest by the members
of the Education Service to the competent authority shall not be accepted and
such members of the service shall be liable to such disciplinary actions and
penalties/punishments as prescribed under the Balochistan Employees Efficiency
and Discipline Act, 2011 (Act VI of 2011)

5. Disciplinary
Proceedings.---The members of the
service including in strikes or lockouts or any illegal act shall be liable to
such penalties/punishments as mentioned in the Balochistan Employees,
Efficiency and Discipline Act, 2011(Act VI of 2011); and all procedure as
mentioned in the said Act, shall be adopted for inflicting such
punishments/penalties.

Power to prohibit strike or lockout or any other illegal act

Balochistan Essential Education Services Bill 2019 Bill No. 01 of 2019 having

perspective.
It

6. Power
to prohibit strike or lockout or any other illegal act.---(1) The Government in the public interest may by
general or special order, prohibit strikes or lockout or any other illegal act
in any Education Institute from such date as may be specified in the order.
(2) Such
order shall be published in the official Gazette and leading News Papers so as
to bring the same to the knowledge of the persons to be affected by the order.
(3) An
order issued under subsection (1) hereinabove shall be enforced for six months
from the date specified therein and the Government may extend the said order
for a further period not exceeding six months
(4) Any
strike or lockout declared or commenced whether before or after issue of the
above said order, by the members of the service shall be illegal.

Punishment for strike or lockout

7. Punishment
for strike or lockout.---Any
member of the service who commits an offence mentioned in section 3(2) of this
Act, shall on conviction be punished with imprisonment, which may extend to one
month or with fine which may extend to one hundred thousand rupees or with
both.

8. Punishment
for giving financial aid to strike or lockout or illegal act.---Any member of the service who knowingly expends
or supplies any money in furtherance or support of a strike or lockout or any
illegal act shall on conviction be punished with imprisonment for a term which
may extend to one month and with fine which may extend to one hundred thousand
rupees or with both.
